results.headline: Labour pledges 1.5 million new homes next parliament
results.quote: Labour will get Britain building again, creating jobs across England, with 1.5 million new homes over the next parliament.

results.headline: Starmer hails biggest renters' rights upgrade in a generation
results.quote: I am very proud — this Government are very proud — of the biggest upgrade in workers' rights in a generation and the biggest upgrade in renters' rights in a generation and of doing the most any Government have ever done to reduce child poverty.

results.headline: Starmer: upgrading renters' rights and building 1.5 million homes
results.quote: We are going to build 1.5 million homes. We are upgrading the rights of renters, because we know how important it is for everyone to have a safe and secure roof over their head.

parties.name: Conservative
parties.summary: The Conservatives commit to passing a Renters Reform Bill to deliver fairness for landlords and renters, abolishing Section 21 no-fault evictions once court reforms are in place, and strengthening grounds for landlords to evict tenants guilty of anti-social behaviour.

results.headline: Conservatives pledge 1.6 million new homes in England
results.quote: We will deliver 1.6 million homes in England in the next Parliament.

parties.name: Liberal Democrats
parties.summary: The Liberal Democrats propose to immediately ban no-fault evictions, make three-year tenancies the default, create a national register of licensed landlords, and proactively enforce clear standards for socially rented homes including strict time limits for repairs.

citations.quote: Delivering a fair deal for renters by immediately banning no-fault evictions, making three-year tenancies the default, and creating a national register of licensed landlords.
Proactively enforcing clear standards for homes that are socially rented, including strict time limits for repairs.

results.headline: Lib Dems pledge to ban no-fault evictions immediately
results.quote: Delivering a fair deal for renters by immediately banning no-fault evictions, making three-year tenancies the default, and creating a national register of licensed landlords.

parties.name: SNP
parties.summary: The SNP calls for the devolution of Housing Benefit and Local Housing Allowance to Scotland, and presses the UK Government to restore capital funding to tackle the housing emergency, with a focus on expanding social housing delivery and addressing the impact of Westminster underinvestment on renters.

citations.quote: Devolve Housing Benefit and Local Housing to tackle child poverty, expand the delivery of social housing and to help fund and encourage investment in house building.
Tackle the housing emergency caused by decades of Westminster underinvestment, a hard Brexit and a £1.3bn cut to the Scottish Government's capital budget from the UK Government.

results.headline: SNP: built 40% more affordable homes per head than England
results.quote: We've built 40% more affordable homes per head than in England.
